Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000568": The Ember team runs its planning on Fridays.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000564": As of 2025-07-17, the ledger service remains owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000548": The billing API is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-06-09, having moved from the Ember team; the Boreal team was recorded by mistake and never held it.  (about: Atlas team, Boreal team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000497": As of 2025-06-24, the reporting service still relies on the ledger service.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000453" [decision]: On 2025-06-06 the Ember team decided that the job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node.  (about: Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000442" [decision]: Ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000404": On 2025-05-14 the Cinder team observed that webhooks' memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder, webhooks)
- memory_id "1000387": On 2025-05-07 the Boreal team pinged the owners of the authentication gateway about the error rate.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000384": On 2025-05-07 the Boreal team noticed that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000319" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the webhook dispatcher deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC.  (about: webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000303" [constraint]: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000284" [constraint]: The reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000253": The ledger service relies on the auth gateway for service tokens, so if the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down.  (about: ledger service, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000230": On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team pinged the owners of the ledger service about the memory growth.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000227": On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team noticed that the ledger service's memory use had grown steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000216" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000180" [decision]: The Ember team does pairing on every production change.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000140": The authentication gateway is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000094": The Ember team is a one-person team consisting of Oskar.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000001": The Atlas team in 2025 consists of Priya Raman and Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
